caseName: Star Chronicle Publishing Co. v. United Press Associations
caseNameFull: Star Chronicle Publishing Company, in Error v. United Press Associations
summary: In error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit. Motion to dismiss or affirm and for damages.
attorneys: Mr. Shepard Barclay for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Gampbell Cummings for the defendant in error. .... ..

opinions.text: Per. Curiam.' Dismissed for want of. jurisdiction. Omaha Railroad Company v. Omaha, 230 U. S. 123; Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561; Chicago Junction Railway Company v. King, 222 U. S. 223; In re Metropolitan Railway Receivership, 208 U. S. 109.
